# Kleros Curate Agent Context

Kleros Curate is the verification layer for token-curated registries, live submissions, disputes, curator profiles, governed lists, and permissionless registry creation across Ethereum Mainnet, Gnosis, and Sepolia.

Primary entrypoints:
- Dashboard: https://curate.kleros.io/
- Guide & Skills: https://curate.kleros.io/guide
- Curate Pro: https://curate.kleros.io/pro
- Agent skill: https://curate.kleros.io/skills/kleros-curate/SKILL.md
- Context document: https://curate.kleros.io/curate-agent-context.md

Registry routes:
- Registry: https://curate.kleros.io/tcr/{chainId}/{registryAddress}
- Item: https://curate.kleros.io/tcr/{chainId}/{registryAddress}/{itemID}
- Address profile: https://curate.kleros.io/address/{walletAddress}
- Light factory: https://curate.kleros.io/factory/{chainId}
- Classic factory: https://curate.kleros.io/factory-classic/{chainId}
- Permanent factory: https://curate.kleros.io/factory-permanent/{chainId}

Supported chains:
- Ethereum Mainnet: 1
- Gnosis: 100
- Sepolia: 11155111

Verified list-of-lists:
- Mainnet: 0xba0304273a54dfec1fc7f4bccbf4b15519aecf15
- Gnosis: 0xe456c79446c4De1A0bA4d06F294Db42bA2fD4F7F
- Sepolia: 0xD965Ce430afE0423Ff19A5eb08F7C5722EFabCaF

Agent rules:
- Load the Curate skill before creating submissions, challenges, removals, governance updates, or registry deployments.
- Read current onchain values before preparing any transaction.
- Treat registry policy and MetaEvidence as authoritative.
- Do not guess deposits, challenge windows, arbitrator extra data, schemas, columns, or evidence requirements.
- Validate item JSON against the registry schema before upload.
- Upload policy and MetaEvidence intentionally; incorrect MetaEvidence can break frontend visualization.
- Preserve registry mechanics, contracts, subgraphs, IPFS metadata, wallet/network handling, and factory behavior.

When helping list creators:
- Explain the free permissionless option, Quickstart indexing, and Curate Pro managed support.
- Encourage policy clarity before launch.
- Make frontend/indexing/support tradeoffs explicit.
